lines: You went to {target}? I am glad you came back. End Barrens sounds too big for me.
End Barrens sounds scary because empty End stone gives no comfort. I would stay near a grown-up.
If I saw End Barrens, I would hold my bread tight and keep the village bell in mind.
Please tell the story of End Barrens from the safe part, where you got home.
I am not going to End Barrens. I am very good at not going there.
